verdict.rationale: Wave's first-party docs cover the whole story. Users can create unlimited invoices on web and mobile with branded templates. Customers can pay online through a 'Pay now' button by credit card, ACH/EFT or Apple Pay, with no separate payment gateway needed. The invoicing page explicitly says you will 'know when an invoice is viewed, becomes due, or gets paid'. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the view/paid tracking and payment flow, since all evidence is vendor marketing.
